response.text:
I can help with that, but deleting/clearing email is a destructive action so I need a couple quick clarifications before I proceed.

Quick choices I need you to confirm
1) Action — what should I do with the Uber messages?
   - Archive (remove from Inbox but keep mail)
   - Move to Trash / Delete (goes to Trash and is permanently deleted after 30 days)
   - Permanently delete now (irreversible) — not recommended without extra confirmation

2) Scope — which messages count as “from Uber”?
   - All senders with addresses at uber.com (recommended; query: from:(@uber.com))
   - Any message that mentions “Uber” (subject/body) — broader, may catch non-Uber senders
   - Specific addresses or senders you want to include/exclude (list them)

3) Time range / labels (optional)
   - Entire mailbox (all dates)
   - Only older than X months (e.g., older_than:6m)
   - Only Inbox / include Promos / include Spam / include All Mail

4) Preview first?
   - I can run a search and show a count and sample subject lines so you can confirm before I modify anything. Would you like that first?

If you confirm Action + Scope (and whether you want a preview), I will proceed. Which combination do you want?
